item.description: In a recent ruling, an Arizona appeals court upheld a decision to dismiss a woman's malpractice claim against her ex-attorney. The court concluded she suffered no direct financial loss from the attorney's missed deadline, despite a $200,000 error in the divorce decree regarding familial debt. item.title: Matt Damon's Water.org reaches 1 million people in Latin America through Ripple partnership
item.description: Water.org, co-founded by Matt Damon and Gary White, works tirelessly to combat the global water crisis. Through a partnership with Ripple, they have secured innovative financing solutions for families in Latin America. Ripple has committed $6 million to support WaterCredit, enabling affordable loans for water access. This initiative has already empowered over 1 million people with safe water, as they strive to reach 200 million by 2030. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
